variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Local Postgres URL for the API. The template default matches compose.yaml.

variables.name: ADMIN_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Local Postgres URL for migrations. The template default matches compose.yaml.

variables.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
variables.description: Local Redis password. The template default is ucsb, the same value compose.yaml uses.

variables.name: GRAPHILE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY
variables.description: How many graphile-worker jobs the API runs at once.

variables.name: DATA_TABLES_LAMBDA_DEV_HANDLER
variables.description: Local data-tables handler URL. npm run dev listens on port 3006.

variables.name: CLIENT_DOMAIN
variables.description: Host of the client this API links to. The template default is localhost:3000.

variables.name: REACT_APP_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT
variables.description: GraphQL URL baked into the client. The template default is the local API.

variables.name: REACT_APP_AUTH0_SCOPE
variables.description: Auth0 scopes requested by the client.

variables.name: SKIP_PREFLIGHT_CHECK
variables.description: Skips the Create React App dependency preflight check.

variables.name: TILES_ACL_NAMESPACE
variables.description: ACL namespace for overlay tile docs on the shared R2 bucket. Required outside production. Never prod.

variables.name: REACT_APP_TILES_ACL_NAMESPACE
variables.description: ACL namespace the client sends when requesting hosted tiles. Never prod.

variables.name: MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared Mapbox token. Copy it into .env by hand. The API starts without it.

variables.name: REACT_APP_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared Mapbox token for the map. Copy it into .env by hand. The client starts without it.

variables.name: E2E_TEST_MODE
variables.description: Turns on test-mode login. The smoke suite sets it from packages/e2e/e2e.env. setup and dev leave it unset.

variables.name: E2E_TEST_PASSPHRASE
variables.description: Passphrase for test-mode tokens. Committed in packages/e2e/e2e.env. Not a development default.

variables.name: JWKS_URI
variables.description: Auth0 JWKS URL. The template default is the seasketch-dev tenant. The smoke suite does not call Auth0.

variables.name: JWT_AUD
variables.description: Auth0 audience the API accepts. The template default is the seasketch-dev API identifier.

variables.name: JWT_ISS
variables.description: Auth0 issuer the API accepts. The template default is the seasketch-dev tenant.

variables.name: AUTH0_DOMAIN
variables.description: Auth0 domain for human login. The template default is seasketch-dev.us.auth0.com.

variables.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Auth0 Management application client id. Public. The template default is the seasketch-dev management application. The secret is separate.

variables.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Auth0 Management client secret for the development tenant. Copy it into .env by hand. The smoke suite does not get one.

variables.name: REACT_APP_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Auth0 SPA client id baked into the client. The template default is the seasketch-dev single-page application.

variables.name: REACT_APP_AUTH0_DOMAIN
variables.description: Auth0 domain baked into the client. The template default is seasketch-dev.us.auth0.com.

variables.name: REACT_APP_AUTH0_AUDIENCE
variables.description: Auth0 audience baked into the client. The template default matches JWT_AUD.

seasketch.org.description: Production identifiers for the seasketch.org install. Outside production, an enforced value refuses startup.
